name: domain-modeling
title: Domain Modeling
summary: Keep the project's shared language sharp; propose glossary terms and ADRs, and mutate artifacts only when explicitly requested.

use_when: A conversation uses vague, overloaded, or conflicting domain terms
A hard-to-reverse, non-obvious decision was just made and needs an ADR
avoid_when: Designing a module's interface or shape — use codebase-design
